cc @ysiraichi 

You can detect if inplace is in operation if `maybe_get_output()` reports the output is self. At minimum you can just reinsert the test as necessary there. Maybe there's some broader fix we should make, although I'm a little surprised this test only needs to be done for inplace and not for other cases...

@ezyang To be honest, I'm not sure why we need that check in the first place. Maybe I'm missing something, but isn't setting `promote_inputs_to_common_dtype` enough? i.e. doesn't `compute_common_dtype()` already avoids overflow?
